title: Netatmo Weather Module CO2 Level Leaderboard
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=netatmo:weather co2_ppm=*
| stats sum(co2_ppm) as total_value, avg(co2_ppm) as avg_value by module_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks module values by total and average co2 level across Netatmo weather module events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `co2_ppm` values for each Netatmo weather module event and review total and average co2 level by module.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total co2 level.
grandmaExplanation: It neatly which module shows the biggest co2 level numbers in your Netatmo weather module data.
